info.name: API Testing Portfolio
info.description:
API testing portfolio project using Postman and DummyJSON REST API.

This collection covers functional API testing, positive and negative testing, CRUD operations, response validation, and authentication testing using automated Postman assertions.

Test scenarios include product retrieval, product creation, product update, product deletion, user authentication, and authenticated endpoint access.

request.description:
Verify that the API returns the expected error response when requesting a product that does not exist.

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 404
    
- Product not found message is returned

Verify that the API can create a new product successfully.

Request data:

- Title: QA Test Product
    
- Price: 100000
    
- Category: test
    

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 201
    
- Product title matches the submitted data

Verify that an existing product can be updated successfully.

Request data:

- Product ID: 1
    
- Updated title: Updated QA Product
    

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 200
    
- Product title is updated correctly

Verify that the API processes a product deletion request successfully.

Request data:

- Product ID: 1
    

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 200
    
- isDeleted is true

Verify that valid user credentials can generate an access token successfully.

Request data:

- Username: emilys
    
- Password: emilyspass
    

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 200
    
- Access token is generated
    
- Access token is not empty

Verify that an authenticated user can access a protected endpoint using a valid access token.

Authentication:

- Bearer Token
    
- Token source: {{accessToken}}
    

Expected result:

- HTTP status code: 200
    
- Authenticated user data is returned
    
- Username matches the expected user: emilys
